secondwind.configuration.title: %s Settings
secondwind.configuration.secondWind.tool: Core settings for the downed state, revives, cooldowns, and combat behavior.
secondwind.configuration.downedTimerSeco: How long a player can stay downed before dying, in seconds.
secondwind.configuration.minimumDownedTi: The shortest allowed downed timer after repeat-down penalties are applied.
secondwind.configuration.timerPenaltyPer: How many seconds are removed from the downed timer for each current penalty stack.
secondwind.configuration.downedSlownessL: Vanilla Slowness level applied while downed. Set to 0 to disable the effect.
secondwind.configuration.forceCrawlingPo: Force downed players into the vanilla swimming/crawling pose. Disable this when another movement or animation mod manages crawling.
secondwind.configuration.downedDamageRed: When enabled, incoming hits shorten a downed player's remaining timer instead of only being cosmetic pressure.
secondwind.configuration.downedDamageCoo: Minimum ticks between hits that can reduce a downed player's timer.
secondwind.configuration.downedDamageReg: When enabled, hits against downed players still apply normal Minecraft damage in addition to any timer reduction.
secondwind.configuration.downedDamagePla: When enabled, canceled hits against downed players still play the player hit sound.
secondwind.configuration.downedDamageApp: When enabled, canceled hits against downed players still push them as if the hit connected.
secondwind.configuration.blockHealingWhi: Prevent health restoration from healing effects and other healing sources while the player is downed.
secondwind.configuration.blockEatingWhil: Prevent downed players from eating food until they are revived or die.
secondwind.configuration.reviveHealthHal: How much health a player has after being revived, measured in half-hearts.
secondwind.configuration.reviveRegenerat: How many seconds of Regeneration II a player receives after being revived.
secondwind.configuration.postReviveInvul: How many seconds of brief invulnerability a player gets after being revived.
secondwind.configuration.cooldownMode.to: Choose how often Second Wind can trigger for a player.
secondwind.configuration.cooldownDuratio: How long the cooldown lasts in seconds when Cooldown Mode is set to Timed Cooldown.
secondwind.configuration.resetCooldownOn: When enabled, dying and respawning fully clears the player's Second Wind cooldown and repeat-down penalty.
secondwind.configuration.multiplayerRevi: Settings for reviving downed players with help from other players.
secondwind.configuration.reviveChannelSe: How long another player must hold the revive interaction before the downed player gets back up.
The maximum distance allowed between the reviver and the downed player during a revive.
secondwind.configuration.reviveInterrupt: When enabled, taking damage interrupts an in-progress multiplayer revive.
secondwind.configuration.killRules.toolt: Controls which kills count for bringing a downed player back up.
secondwind.configuration.allowPassiveKil: Allow passive mobs to count as valid kills for reviving a downed player.
secondwind.configuration.allowPlayerKill: Allow player kills to count as valid kills for reviving a downed player.
secondwind.configuration.allowPetKills.t: Allow tamed or owned pets to count kills for reviving their downed owner.
secondwind.configuration.allowVoidSecond: Allow Second Wind to activate from void or out-of-world damage.
Visual and audio feedback shown to players during the downed state.
secondwind.configuration.enableDownedVig: Show a dark vignette effect while the player is downed.
secondwind.configuration.enableDesaturat: Show a desaturated red screen tint while downed when supported.
secondwind.configuration.enableDownedBlo: Apply a soft bloom-style blur while downed when supported.
secondwind.configuration.enableSounds.to: Play Second Wind sound effects when available.
secondwind.configuration.enableChatMessa: Broadcast chat messages when players are downed or revived.
secondwind.configuration.localizeChatMes: Send downed and revived chat announcements as translatable messages so each client can display them in their selected language.
secondwind.configuration.enableSecondWin: Show the Second Wind item activation and pop-up animation after being revived.
secondwind.configuration.useSimpleDowned: Use a compact text downed timer near the crosshair instead of the styled last-stand bar.
